posts.author: Zakarijazh
posts.body:
Is there a way to make a state that increases a parameter like Atk by 1, and then coninually be able to reapply and increase it further?
turn 1:  character uses 'cheer' and raises atk by 1
turn 2: character uses 'cheer' and raises atk by 2
turn 3: character uses 'cheer' and raises atk by 3
etc.

One way you might could do this is in your Troops\Battle Event.
Set the Conditions to Turn End
.
If : Actor 1 is affected by Cheer
Change Parameter : Actor 1, Attack +1
End
Sometimes I have trouble understanding what posters are asking.  So if this isn't what you mean just ignore the post.
